authorization: The same host Codex session may execute the externally pinned bootstrap script, then enter WU-05 implementer mode after readiness. No separate human merge is required. This narrowly overrides the earlier blanket branch-preparation ban.
external_pin: Exact package SHA from the delivered publication receipt or PR #21; never infer the pin from a moving ref.
protocol: extract runner and validator from the pinned Git commit
inspect clean preserved review or its exact clean [review, package] merge
run real package/supplement checks in detached worktree before merge
require zero exits and structured marker, legacy_marker, pin_marker PASS fields
merge exact ordered parents or revalidate that same merge without a new commit
preserve command logs under Git common directory
start source repair only after LOCAL_WU05_AUTHORITY_READY
inventory_rule: Keep existing root and supplement hash checks. Cover added bootstrap files and executable payload using the externally pinned Git tree, not an incomplete hardcoded list. The existing loader supplies a transparent inventory-only compatibility repair; --dump-source emits its exact effective code.
parent_content_rule: For a pre-existing required path unchanged on the package side since merge-base, retain exact REVIEW bytes. Otherwise require exact package bytes. No guessed conflict resolution.
verification_scope: 11 tests: 8 real-Git lifecycle cases with explicit dependency stand-ins, plus 3 cases exercising real dependency-validator code. Git IDs and metadata are synthetic. Actual local e95 source/campaign replay is not claimed.
on_failure: Never reset or stash. Abort a conflicted merge. Preserve a completed merge on post-validation failure, its logs, and the original review ancestry.
review_policy: Reuse the existing one read-only fresh repair review and final differential audit. No new review tier.
